# XCOM 2 War of the Chosen

## What are locations and items in this game?

> [!NOTE]
> Resistance Communications and Resistance Radio research projects are ignored by randomization, meaning they will have to be researched in-game before XCOM can begin contacting other regions and building radio relays.

### Locations

- Completion of research and shadow projects
- Completion of chosen hunt covert actions
- Ranks of each soldier class
- First kill of each enemy type
- First use of each item type

### Items

- Research/shadow project unlocks (including story progress)
- Chosen hunt covert action unlocks, i.e. faction influence, chosen strongholds
- Promotions for each soldier class
- Resources, i.e. supplies, intel, elerium cores, etc.
- Weapon upgrades, PCSs
- Staff, i.e. scientists, engineers
- Traps, i.e. Avatar project progress, enemy reinforcements, etc.

## What do location checks and items look like in this game?

When reaching a location, a notification appears informing the player of the item they found and who it belongs to.

Items are only received in their respective layer. When the game receives an item, a notification appears informing the player of what they got and from whom.

## How sync-viable is this game?

Various features have been added to reduce the length of a full campaign (such as certain missions being skipped and soldiers gaining more XP) and there are multiple options for alternate goals. The length of a playthrough still heavily depends on individual options, mods, and player skill. For sync settings, try the 1 or 2 stronghold goal options first and experiment from there.

# XCOM 2 War of the Chosen Archipelago Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [XCOM 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/268500/XCOM_2/) with the [War of the Chosen DLC](https://store.steampowered.com/app/593380/XCOM_2_War_of_the_Chosen/) installed through Steam
- [XCOM 2 WotC Archipelago Mod](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281191663)
    - Files for [manual installation](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/x2wotc/docs/mod_manual_installation.md) available [here](https://github.com/Snyax/WOTCArchipelago/releases)
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- [XCOM 2 WotC APWorld](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/releases)

## Optional Software

- **(Strongly recommended)** Any dedicated XCOM 2 WotC Mod Launcher like the [Alternative Mod Launcher (AML)](https://github.com/X2CommunityCore/xcom2-launcher)
- **(Strongly recommended)** [Mod Config Menu for WotC](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=667104300)
- **(Strongly recommended)** [Universal Tracker APWorld](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases)
- Alien Hunters and Shen's Last Gift DLCs are supported but not required.

## Setup

### XCOM 2 War of the Chosen Mod

1. Install [XCOM 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/268500/XCOM_2/) and the [War of the Chosen DLC](https://store.steampowered.com/app/593380/XCOM_2_War_of_the_Chosen/) through Steam.
2. Subscribe to the [XCOM 2 WotC Archipelago Mod](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281191663).
3. **(Optional)** Install any dedicated Mod Launcher (e.g. [AML](https://github.com/X2CommunityCore/xcom2-launcher)).
4. Launch XCOM 2 War of the Chosen with the AP mod enabled.

### XCOM 2 WotC AP Client

1. Download and install the latest [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) release.
2. Download the latest release of the [XCOM 2 WotC APWorld](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/releases). Double-click it to install automatically, or copy it to your Archipelago installation's `custom_worlds` folder manually.
3. **(Optional)** Download the latest release of the [Universal Tracker APWorld](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases). Double-click it to install automatically, or copy it to your Archipelago installation's `custom_worlds` folder manually.
4. Launch the XCOM 2 War of the Chosen AP Client from the Archipelago Launcher.

## Generating a Multiworld

1. Follow the general [Archipelago Guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en) for generating and hosting a Multiworld.
    - Multiworld will have to be generated locally but can be hosted on the website.
    - [APWorld](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/releases) can be found on GitHub.
    - [Options Template](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/releases) can be generated with the 'Generate Template Options' button in the Archipelago Launcher, or found on GitHub.

## Joining a Multiworld

0. Before you can connect to a slot, the AP mod must be installed. Make sure you've followed the setup instructions above.
1. In the client, connect to the address the Multiworld is hosted at.
2. Provide your slot name (the name you entered into your YAML).
3. If asked, provide the room password that was set during generation.
4. You may be prompted to provide the path to your installation of XCOM 2, most likely ending in `/XCOM 2`.
    - If the client doesn't find the AP mod there, it will also ask for your Steam workshop directory. This should only concern you if you have the mod installed in a different Steam archive to the game, e.g. on another drive.
    - If you set the path incorrectly, you can change it anytime with the `/game_path` client command, or reset it with `/reset_paths` so the client will prompt you again on the next connection attempt. The same goes for `/workshop_path`.
5. If everything worked, the client will tell you that you're connected. Restart the game if it was already running and start playing!

1.0.0 is here! This release includes many, many new features and improvements, and there's a good chance it includes one or two new bugs as well. If you run into any issues or weird behavior, or would like to give some general feedback, please write in the [Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1037751568700805141)! If you'd like to stay on the previous version, e.g. to continue playing in an ongoing async, make sure to [manually install](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/x2wotc/docs/mod_manual_installation.md) the mod to prevent Steam from auto-updating.
## Changes
### New Features
- Added Ranksanity
  - Enable `Ranksanity` option to add new items and locations for soldier class promotions and rank-up events
  - Toggle `Global Promotions` option to determine behavior of excluded classes
  - Fully LWOTC-compatible!
- Added DeathLink
  - Enable `DeathLink` option in your YAML or change your mind via in-game Mod Config Menu at any time
  - Set `DeathLink Chance` option to play dice with your soldiers' lives (can also be changed in MCM)
  - Added more options for better access to exclusive soldier classes to enable less punishing DeathLinks
- Overhauled trap items
  - Removed `[Trap] Force Level +1` and added many more traps, both for the Strategy and Tactical layers
  - Enable `Disable Turn One Traps` option to ignore tactical traps from before a mission started
  - Enable `Disable All Traps` in MCM if you bit off more than you can chew (it happens)
  - Traps may range anywhere from 'mild inconvenience' to 'potentially run-threatening', enable whichever ones you like with the `Active Traps` option and please give feedback if they feel too strong or boring!
- Overhauled progressive weapon items
  - New `[Tech] Progressive Gun` track includes rifle, shotgun, cannon, and sniper techs, the order of later items is shuffled and different each seed
  - `Split Progressive Items` option allows splitting these techs into separate rifle/shotgun and cannon/sniper tracks
- Added `progressive` option to `Chosen Huntsanity`, grouping Chosen Hunt items into three progressive items
- Added `Exclude Post-Goal Locations` option to accomodate early-goal sync settings
- Added `Enemy Plando Preset` option, feel free to suggest new presets if there are fun settings you like using :)
### Client
- Overhauled connection, version checking, and writing to game config
  - Client no longer prompts user for game path on launch but on connection
  - All version checking now happens directly in the client, connection will be closed if versions are incompatible
  - Added `/game_path`, `/workshop_path`, and `/reset_paths` client commands to remove need to open `host.yaml`
  - `/version` client command now displays world and mod version info when connected
  - Client now prints an error on connection when config file is missing version info
- Added `/progressive` client command to print info about active progressive items
- Client now prints names of valid progressive items if user attempts to hint one of their stages
- Client now supports launching from WebHost by clicking the slot name on the room page
- Proxy is now properly assigned a free port by the OS instead of using a generic default
### Generation
- Logic now tightly follows `Remove Corpse Costs` option
- `get_filler_item_name()` now respects filler share options
- Various logic difficulty tweaks, especially for early locations
- Various optimizations, massively lowering generation times
- Improvements to item and location name groups
### Mod
- Mod no longer allows launching while disconnected or while connected with incompatible version info
- Minimized GameStates added to history in Strategy layer to significantly reduce risk of save file bloat
- Improved guardrails around offline location checking
- Replaced UI strings for objectives waiting on multiworld items
- Streamlined Chosen Hunt locations for more intuitive behavior
- Partial research project hints now reveal item classification in addition to flavor text
- LWOTC rebels and VIPs now scale with items received from the multiworld
- Removed science and engineering requirements from proving ground projects
- Corpse costs are now also removed from proving ground projects if the option is enabled
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where Avatars could spawn damaged in the final mission
- Fixed a bug where covert action risks would still appear after their associated Chosen had already been defeated
- Fixed incomplete proving ground and skulljack logic in LWOTC
- Fixed logic error in Muton Destroyer APWorld mod
